content: Abram ọmaana Lọt akhọm ayok ẹkhaan
Mẹ wọ ofon, Abram obina orenga k'obhon ebira kw'Ijip, otzima kwanọng kwẹ ọmaana ekpo pyẹ biphyir, ochina k'ẹkhọma cha Nẹgẹv, wa Lọt ọtzọn-ẹ abẹ.
Wa Abram ọkk'ọkkọkkaa ọn-ọda, kw'ọkhaam etzirakpo, ọmaana silva ttara gol k'ọhaabh.

Ttẹwọr ma Nẹgẹv, Abram ochina ororo k'orenga kwẹ, om-obhing k'obe-k'obe matzẹmaa okwu opyiri ka Bẹtẹl, obiro owobha m'ibe nna s'iwobh k'ottem kwa Bẹtẹl ọmaana Ayi, kw'ode ibe s'iwa ikhira sẹ ichi eden iwobha,
kw'ode ibe s'iwa ọkk'eden ọcha osi ijafọhnibe. Ma wọ kw'iwa Abram owobh okpobha che ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.
Iwa Lọt kw'ọm-ọtzọn Abram abẹ, obiro ọkhaama arukhimaan, ọmaana abhaam, ttara okhira f'atzọhmnọng arukhi.
Yina, wa araraari p'abira abenga etzirakpo pyabẹ m'ibe nna dọk kade, da iwa ẹkhakhaama chabẹ ẹn-ẹhaabhi ẹyọhnga irek sa bẹ arukhi, maa bẹ ibe rani dọk kafha aruk.
Wa ẹkhọhr etto k'ottem kw'akkeri-etzirakpo py'Abram ttara akkeri-etzirakpo pya Lọt. M'ogbe nwa, aKenaan ọmaana aPẹriz bẹ atzọn aruk m'ẹkhọma nda dani.
Mẹ wọ osi, Abram on-oben Lọt bi, “Kọ ttara kaam mode votte. Tte ẹkhọhr eningi k'ottem kwaman anọng afa eyini, tte akkeri-etzirakpo pọ ttara paam aningi ẹkhọhr abira akhaama.

Irerek nna biphyir s'iwobh ma, iwobh ka maan ka mbọhk. Tte mọkhọm ayok ẹkhaan. Kọ tzekha okhubha kw'ọdaakh-ọ, ifha aruk. Idikha kọ atzọk okhubha kw'odimbọhk, kaam ńdọkha okhubha kwa kwabọhk. Idikha atzọk okhubha kwa kwabọhk, kaam ńdọkha okhubha kw'odimbọhk.”

Mẹ wọ ofon, Lọt otzini chen okkeri irek s'ẹttẹri cha Jọrdan, ore bi, sẹ ijibh-ojibh, okhuri da sẹ ihaabhi asi mach'owoni kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, ibiri ijibh mach'irek s'Ijip k'okhubha kwa Zoar. (M'ogbe nwa, wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ibhon sa Sodom ọmaana Gomora otzima odimi.)
Mẹ wọ osi, Lọt otzekha ẹttẹri cha Jọrdan k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin ọnang for sẹ. Mando wọ kwa Lọt ọmaana Abram areng akhọm ayok ẹkhaan.
Wa Abram, orukhi k'ẹkhọma cha Kenaan, k'ogbe kwa Lọt orukhi k'ibhon s'ideden k'ẹttẹri, ottima ikhira sẹ ọbaanga Sodom.
Wa anọng pa Sodom ade anọng p'asi ọmmaana-tzama, bẹ am-abira asi ẹkhọngkwuri ayong-oyongi k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.

Mada Abram ọmaana Lọt akk'ayok ẹkhaan akhọma, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okwu oben Abram bi, “Tzini chen ttẹwọr mẹ da abe, akkeri k'ebir-ebira, ttara k'ẹrakha-ẹrakha, abira akkeri kẹ da ewuchen em-eyin, ọmaana kẹ da ewuchen em-edimi.
Ẹkhọma nduma ch'are mẹ biphyir, kaam ńdọkha chẹ nnang kọ, ọmaana va pọ, ttara va pa va pọ, maa ogbe ode.
Kaam ńsi va pa va pọ ahaabh, akher oyeyeng kw'irerek kw'ọnọng on-ofha obhik.
Bina, arenga akhọri ẹkhọma nda k'adum ọmaana ẹ̀kpá chẹ biphyir, okhuri bi, chẹ dọ cha kaam ńnang-ọ.”
Mẹ wọ osi, Abram, orenga ọkhọri ẹkhọma nda maa opyiri ka Hẹbrọn. Okwu osi oruk kwẹ ọbaanga nchi sa ndeden sa Mamrẹ. M'ibe nna rọ s'iwa obiro osi ijafọhnibe ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.
